## Problem And Behavior

Link the agreed issue. Explain the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record `npm run check`, `npm run audit:staged` and relevant results. State what was
not tested. Separate synthetic checks from native UI, model and live-provider proof.

## Source Boundary And Rights

- [ ] Only reviewed manifest paths are included; provenance changes have reasons.
- [ ] No generated data, credentials, customer records, private screenshots or unapproved artwork.
- [ ] New third-party material has an identified origin and reviewed notices/rights.
- [ ] Apache-2.0, LICENSE/NOTICE and third-party attribution are preserved.
- [ ] Source changes do not imply approval for app binaries, npm publication or deployment.

## Remaining Limits

Mention retained cloud coupling, compatibility gaps and follow-up work needed.
